DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_BlackPuppy:
The black flames are merely warm to the touch, 
but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. 
Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_BlackPuppy:
When activated, 
uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby <itemName id=|Chromium| style=|Status_Keyword|/>. 

While fighting together, 
<itemName id=|Chromium| style=|Status_Keyword|/> acquisition increases by <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
